name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs for two weeks. This lets us measure real impact without risking disruption. Trade-off: slower feedback for contributors, but we avoid breaking changes. After two weeks, we’ll compare metrics to decide next steps.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode won’t catch PR-Agent’s worst flaw: false negatives. It normalizes bad reviews by hiding them, not fixing the core problem. Instead, run a controlled A/B test—half the PRs get PR-Agent, half don’t—then measure *both* false positives *and* false negatives against a human baseline. The data settles it: if false negatives spike in the test group, we scrap the tool; if not, we roll it out with guardrails.
